title: Orleans 2C | 30a Condo Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: A gulf-facing, 2-bedroom rental with an amazing fusion of style, luxury, and convenience; Orleans 2C is an amazing vacation rental for your next trip. Click here to learn more!
description_expanded:
The Orleans Grand Suite is the only true gulf facing Orleans condo vacation rental available.

Newly built, this professionally designed sophisticated residence is located next to Rosemary Beach Town Hall, south of 30-A:

74 Town Hall Road, Rosemary Beach.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

2 King Bedrooms

2 Twin Bunks (note that these are built-in hall bunks with access to the 3rd full bath)

3 Full Bathrooms

Sleeps 5-6

Wolf and Subzero kitchen

Keurig and Drip Coffee Makers

Expansive Gulf facing balcony

The Orleans is a blend of ultimate fusion of style, luxury, and convenience, all just steps away from beautiful white-sand beaches.

Tony Cappoli Interiors of New York blended a traditional coastal design with modern lines. The lobby's crisp, white walls serve as a canvas showcasing Trowbridge prints accented by wrought iron and wood details.

Open spaces and sleek stainless-steel appliances play well with a mix of modern light fixtures and classic crown molding.

Access to Rosemary Beach pools and beach gates is provided.

Luxury fixtures and furnishings throughout blend to create the feel of a luxury hotel suite.

Pool: Barbados Pool is 4 homes away.

Beach: Boardwalk G and H are a 2 min walk.

Parking: 1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit. Passes for street parking additional cars provided.

Dining:

Ground floor: Wine Garden

Top Floor: Pescado Fine Dining

Features:

Wolf range

Wolf hood

Wolf microwave

Sub-Zero refrigerator

Asko dishwasher

Blanco Quatrus sink

Custom cabinetry and molding throughout

Waxed Calcutta marble tile in entry ways

Imported natural limestone and ceramic tile

Caesar stone countertops throughout

PID high-performance hardwood floors

Waterworks fixtures and hardware

Dornbracht kitchen faucets

Kohler bathroom sinks and tubs

ToTo Toilets

Trustily cabinetry - Emtek hardware

Visual Comfort Lighting
rooms_guidance: Full Bathroom for 2 Twin Bunks: Toilet + Shower
